_description: Session annotations for Pathogenika telemetry files. Raw JSON files are preserved as-is. This file provides corrected metadata for analysis.

playerTypeStatus.missing: playerType field added to class but not written to JSON export
playerTypeStatus.partial-polluted: playerType present but some AI events incorrectly tagged as human
playerTypeStatus.clean: All events correctly attributed to human or ai

teamMapping.Team 1: Pathogen (virus, bacteria — Replicate, Emit abilities, dock to capture nodes)
teamMapping.Team 2: Immune (neutrophils, NK cells, T cells, macrophages — melee kills, recapture nodes by killing infected cells)
